notes.title: Playtest Exclusive - Projectile Feedback
notes.notes: Projectiles is still a very iffy issue with the nature of Liminal Void as it was never meant to be a shooter. Until V1.1 we'll be experimenting with projectiles until its release. It shouldn't effect the game mechanics, but visually it might. That's what playtesting is about!
